question: Who transmitted the teaching concerning the auspicious-feeding earth-moving yoginīs?
premises: The subject concerns the earth-moving yoginīs.
They are described as good eaters.
inference: An earth-moving yoginī transmitted the teaching concerning the auspicious-feeding earth-movers.
uncertainties: subhakṣāṇāṃ may mean good-eating, auspicious-feeding, or consuming auspicious offerings.
plain_english: O beloved, the teaching concerning the earth-moving yoginīs, the good eaters, was told by an earth-moving yoginī.
